The payable open items and settlements were published under the purchasing invoice resource while the payables subledger lived inside the purchasing module (4.4, 4.6). Slice 4.7 gives the subledger its own module, and its endpoints move to /api/v1/payables (open-items, open-items/aging, settlements, settlements/apply, proposals) with the same shapes; the purchasing paths served for two days of the unreleased M4 milestone and had no external consumer. The invoice's payables tab reads the payables module.
